definitions.explanation: A paved or maintained path designed for walking, typically found in parks, along rivers, or through scenic areas. Unlike ordinary sidewalks, a {遊歩道|ゆうほどう} is specifically intended for leisurely walking and enjoyment of the surroundings.

⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{遊歩道|ゆうほどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{整備|せいび}→整備：04037_seibi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new walking path was built in the park.

examples.english: Taking a stroll along the tree-lined walkway is my daily morning routine.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{遊歩|ゆうほ}→遊歩：25658_yuuho⟧ (strolling, walking for pleasure) and {道|どう} (path, road). Refers specifically to paths designed for pedestrians to enjoy walking, often in natural or scenic settings. These paths are typically well-maintained, sometimes paved with wood or stone, and may include railings, benches, or informational signs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遊歩道|ゆうほどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk along a promenade
- {遊歩道|ゆうほどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散策|さんさく}→散策：07618_sansaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take a stroll along a walkway
- {遊歩道|ゆうほどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整備|せいび}する→整備する：17849_seibisuru⟧: to develop/maintain a walking path
- ⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧{遊歩道|ゆうほどう}: a seaside promenade

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{散歩道|さんぽみち}→散歩道：23492_sanpomichi⟧: walking path — more casual; any path one habitually walks, not necessarily a designated trail
- ⟦{歩道|ほどう}→歩道：03723_hodou⟧: sidewalk, pavement — a general pedestrian path along a road, not specifically for leisure
- {自然歩道|しぜんほどう}: nature trail — a designated hiking path through natural terrain, often longer and more rugged
